title: DuckStation 0.1-11391: official stable release
summary: DuckStation published 0.1-11391 on May 30, 2026. The release record documents an official stable release for the PlayStation emulator project.

blocks.text: The DuckStation project published version 0.1-11391 on May 30, 2026. GitHub marks this entry as a release; this distinction is preserved here so the build is not mistaken for a different update channel.

The official notes highlight the following changes: b0c277b10 optimization scanline-modern-ex.fx ( 3733). 717424209 GameDB: Various fixes ( 3734). 8dad651a2 GameDB: Add disc set for Persona 2 - Eternal Punishment (USA) ( 3735). 023c0823d Qt: Update French translation by Corrigo.
